results.reader_title: Evaluating Delphi survey accuracy in transportation: Evidence from Japanese technology foresight
results.reader_what: A historical Delphi validation study found only 25% realisation accuracy across 167 Japanese transport-technology topics.
results.reader_why: Empirical method scrutiny informs calibration and trust of expert Delphi foresight.
results.reader_more: The study evaluates 647 topic-survey observations from 1992, 1997 and 2001 against actual technology developments. Second survey rounds and greater self-rated expertise did not yield greater observed accuracy; transfer across sectors is uncertain.

results.reader_what: JRC reviewed 1,383 uranium-circularity papers and distinguished twelve supply-chain circularity strategies for EU security.
